page.description: The hosts agents run on, and what each host’s seam earns.
page.loading: Reading the runtimes of this workspace

tiles.runtimesBasis: {count, plural, one {# agent enrollment recorded; no host row yet} other {# agent enrollments recorded; no host row yet}}
tiles.agentsHostedBasis: a host is shared; its hooks see every one of them
tiles.highestTierBasis: computed per run from what was actually routed
tiles.degradedBasis: a gap is a hole in the record, not a failed run

hosts.title: Enrolled hosts
hosts.more: The first {count} enrollments are listed. More are recorded than this page reads.
hosts.note: The tier is a property of the seam, not of the agent: two agents on one host earn the same tier, and the same agent moved to a weaker host earns less. It is computed per run from what was actually routed and is never upgraded after the fact.

ladder.title: The tier ladder
ladder.label: The tier ladder
ladder.observe: Recorded only. No hook is installed and nothing is delivered.
ladder.harness: Hooks installed. Steering is delivered and the four blocking hook events can refuse: client-attested and fail-open.
ladder.gateway: Model and MCP traffic routed through the gateway. Metering observed, budgets enforced on routed traffic.
ladder.contained: The agent runs under an OS sandbox whose only egress is the gateway. The only tier that earns the word enforced.
ladder.note: Only contained earns the word enforced. On observe nothing is delivered and nothing can refuse, which is why an agent with no runtime still has an identity and a toolbelt and receives no steering.

empty.title: No runtime is enrolled
empty.body: Until a host enrolls, an agent has an identity and a toolbelt but no hook is installed. Its runs are graded observe, and no report can say more.

cli.title: Enroll from the CLI
cli.body: Run this on the host, in the repository the agent works in. It enrolls the machine under the agent's key and installs its hooks.
cli.note: Nothing on this page installs a hook. Enrollment runs on the host itself.

error.title: Runtimes could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered <c>{code}</c>. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.

denied.title: You cannot see the runtimes of this workspace
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.signedInValue: {name} · {orgRole} on the organization · {wsRole} on this workspace

pending.title: Access to the runtimes of this workspace is waiting for approval

stub.requestBody: A request would ask an organization owner for {permission} and record the grant in the audit record with both your names. No capability records a request yet, so ask an owner directly. Owners grant roles on the Roles page.
stub.incidentBody: An incident would record this failure, the code {code} and when it happened, for the people who run this workspace. No capability opens an incident from the console yet. Send the code to your organization owner.
stub.smokeBody: A smoke session would run one turn on {hostname}, recorded like any other run, so you can see the hooks answer. No capability starts a session on a host from the console yet. Run one turn of the agent on the host itself.

detail.subtitle: <kind>kind</kind> · {platform} · started by <who>who</who>
detail.collectorGaps: telemetry gaps in the last 24h not recorded
detail.hookEnforce: tacho-hook {version} · fails closed against its cached bundle
detail.hookObserve: tacho-hook {version} · allows when its bundle is stale, because this host is in observe mode
detail.modelLoopback: the harness config names the loopback proxy, as the daemon last reported it
detail.modelDirect: model traffic goes from the harness to its provider; routing it is the gateway tier

agents.title: Agents on this host
agents.none: This host is enrolled and no agent is assigned to it. It records nothing until one runs here.
agents.note: Every agent here is seen through the same hooks and earns the same tier. An agent’s identity, its steering and its toolbelt are its own; only the seam is shared.

rollback.title: Rollback
rollback.note: If hooks are stripped by hand instead, the next run records hooks_removed and the tier falls to observe. It is never upgraded after the fact.

unenroll.title: Unenroll {hostname}?
unenroll.body: Calls routed through Oxagen are refused from this host from now on. The hooks stay on the host until the rollback command runs there, and they refuse each call once the collector reads the new status.
unenroll.scope: This revokes the enrollment of {agent} on this machine. Another agent enrolled on the same machine keeps its own.

failure.denied: Your roles do not let you unenroll a host. An organization Owner or Admin can. Nothing was changed.
failure.notFound: This enrollment no longer exists. Nothing was changed.
failure.refused: This write was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: This enrollment id is not one the write accepts. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: This write is waiting for approval. Access request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: This write could not be answered: {code}. Nothing was changed.
